description: Search the Victoria & Albert Museum (V&A) — the world's leading art & design museum. Find objects across 1M+ items (furniture, fashion, ceramics, photographs, paintings, jewellery, sculpture) by keyword. Returns id, title, maker, date, place, type, and thumbnail. Use the returned id with get_object for full details. Keyless.

query.description: Free-text keyword search (e.g. "Jasper Morrison chair", "Tudor portrait", "Japanese ceramics").

with_images.description: If true, only return objects that have images (default false).

name: search_objects
title: Search Objects
